pins.title: The shelter that fits in your palm
pins.sub: An emergency bivy traps body heat if an injury or bad weather keeps you out after dark.

pins.title: Get the permit first
pins.sub: Enter the Angels Landing permit lottery, start early on short days, and check flash flood forecasts.

pins.title: Not thirsty? Drink anyway
pins.sub: Cold air dulls your thirst, but you still lose water. Sip every 15 to 20 minutes.

pins.title: What to wear
pins.sub: Start a little cool, and add a layer as soon as you stop.

pins.title: Pick the right trail
items: A clear payoff: falls, lake, view
pins.sub: Allow about 30 minutes per mile, plus an hour for every 1,000 ft of climbing.
